description: A flat, single-colour silhouette of the character's own rig, standing behind them, that acts like a stand and does its own thing behind them. Current colourway: purple silhouette.
future_use: To make any character ACT like a stand user for a beat, stage that character's own rig (or their FLA rig pieces) behind them as their coloured shadow. This does not make Cape Jones a stand user.
repo_push: none made by this save alone
source: character's own v7c rig pieces, flattened to one colour, no show character
